C., et al. (2017). LXCat: An Open-Access, Web-Based Platform for Data Needed for Modeling Low Temperature Plasmas. Plasma Process. Polym. 14, 1600098.
datasets.how_to_get: Download it yourself from www.lxcat.net, following data/reference/README.md, then run: python scripts/fetch_reference.py lxcat YOUR_FILE

datasets.title: Electron collisions with argon and its four 1s levels (excitation, ionization, elastic)
datasets.source: LXCat, BSR database (B-spline R-matrix calculations by O. Zatsarinny and K. Bartschat), BSR-500 model; 177 processes for e/Ar and e/Ar(1s5, 1s4, 1s3, 1s2)
datasets.citation: BSR database, www.lxcat.net, retrieved on November 2, 2026 (date in the file header). O. Zatsarinny 2006 Comp. Phys. Commun. 174, 273; O. Zatsarinny and K. Bartschat 2013 J. Phys. B: At. Mol. Opt. Phys. 46, 112001.
datasets.how_to_get: Download it yourself from www.lxcat.net (BSR database; species e and Ar, Ar(4s[3/2]2), Ar(4s[3/2]1), Ar(4s'[1/2]0), Ar(4s'[1/2]1); all processes), following data/reference/README.md, then run: python scripts/fetch_reference.py lxcat YOUR_FILE --dataset lxcat_bsr_argon

datasets.how_to_get: Download it yourself from www.lxcat.net (Itikawa database; species e and H2O; all processes), following data/reference/README.md, then run: python scripts/fetch_reference.py lxcat YOUR_FILE --dataset lxcat_itikawa_h2o
